    • get

      public static UserSessionManager get(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, boolean create)
      Gets the session preferences object for the current user session. If create is false and no session exists, returns a temporary default manager without creating a new HttpSession.
      Parameters:
      request - the servlet request
      create - whether to create a session if one does not exist
      Returns:
      the session preferences for this user
